# Worked Research Studies {#plan-ch25}

::: {.planned-chapter}
Planned
:::

Presents complete investigations so the reader can see how the book's principles interact when the data and conclusions are imperfect.

**Subtopics.** Estimating an equity impact curve; diagnosing time-of-day effects; estimating transient-impact decay; designing and evaluating adaptive POV; modeling passive fills and adverse selection; futures execution around a roll; reproducing Almgren-Chriss and a propagator model; comparing a learned policy with a controlled baseline.
